alert: High p95 latency on checkout: 15000.0 ms (no baseline yet)
summary: The checkout service is suffering from memory starvation, causing high latency and timeouts when calling downstream services like email. The product-catalog service is also hitting its memory limits.
symptoms: Context deadline exceeded errors in checkout logs.
Memory usage for checkout and product-catalog frequently hitting 95-100% of their 20MB limits.

root_cause.description: The checkout service is experiencing resource starvation due to tight memory limits (20MB), leading to high latency and context deadline exceeded errors when communicating with dependencies. The product-catalog service is similarly constrained.

evidence.quote: failed to send order confirmation: failed POST to email service: Post \"http://email:6060/send_order_confirmation\": context deadline exceeded
evidence.explanation: Checkout service is experiencing high p95 latency and context deadline exceeded errors when calling the email service.
Checkout service is hitting its memory limit, which is likely causing performance degradation and timeouts.
Product-catalog service is also hitting its memory limit, which may be contributing to overall system instability.

ruled_out: The email service itself appears healthy, so the timeouts are likely caused by the checkout service's inability to process requests in a timely manner due to resource pressure.

proposed_action.reason: the runbook has no approved action for 'resource_starvation'; escalating to a human

prevention: Increase memory limits for the checkout and product-catalog services to prevent resource starvation. Investigate why these services are consuming so much memory.
